using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Duplicati.Library.Modules.Builtin;
using Moq;
using Moq.Protected;
using Xunit;

namespace Duplicati.Library.Modules.Builtin.Tests;

public class SendTelegramMessageTests
{
    private const string VALID_BOT_ID = "testbot";
    private const string VALID_API_KEY = "testkey";
    private const string VALID_CHANNEL_ID = "123456789";
    private const string VALID_TOPIC_ID = "123";

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendMessageChunk_ValidParameters_SuccessfulHttpResponse_LogsWarningWhenNotOk()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockHttpMessageHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
        mockHttpMessageHandler
            .Protected()
            .Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>(
                "SendAsync",
                ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(),
                ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
            .ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StringContent("{\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"test error\"}")
            });

        var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpMessageHandler.Object);
        mockHttpClient.Timeout = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan;

        // Create reflection-accessible instance
        var sendTelegram = new SendTelegramMessage();
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_botid", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_BOT_ID);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_apikey", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_API_KEY);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_channelId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_CHANNEL_ID);

        var message = "test message";
        var partNumber = 1;
        var totalParts = 1;

        // Act
        var exception = await Record.ExceptionAsync(() => 
            InvokeSendMessageChunkPrivate(sendTelegram, message, partNumber, totalParts, mockHttpClient));

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(exception); // No exception thrown
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendMessageChunk_MissingBotId_ThrowsException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var sendTelegram = new SendTelegramMessage();
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_botid", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, "");
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_apikey", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_API_KEY);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_channelId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_CHANNEL_ID);

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Record.ExceptionAsync(() => 
            InvokeSendMessageChunkPrivate(sendTelegram, "test message", 1, 1, null));
        
        Assert.NotNull(exception);
        Assert.IsType<Exception>(exception);
        Assert.Contains("Telegram Bot ID is required", exception.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendMessageChunk_MissingApiKey_ThrowsException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var sendTelegram = new SendTelegramMessage();
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_botid", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_BOT_ID);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_apikey", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, "");
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_channelId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_CHANNEL_ID);

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Record.ExceptionAsync(() => 
            InvokeSendMessageChunkPrivate(sendTelegram, "test message", 1, 1, null));
        
        Assert.NotNull(exception);
        Assert.IsType<Exception>(exception);
        Assert.Contains("Telegram API Key is required", exception.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendMessageChunk_MultipleParts_FormatsMessageCorrectly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockHttpMessageHandler = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
        mockHttpMessageHandler
            .Protected()
            .Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>(
                "SendAsync",
                ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(),
                ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
            .ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StringContent("{\"ok\": true}")
            });

        var mockHttpClient = new HttpClient(mockHttpMessageHandler.Object);
        mockHttpClient.Timeout = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan;

        var sendTelegram = new SendTelegramMessage();
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_botid", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_BOT_ID);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_apikey", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_API_KEY);
        typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_channelId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(sendTelegram, VALID_CHANNEL_ID);

        var message = "test message";
        var partNumber = 1;
        var totalParts = 2; // Multiple parts

        // Act
        await InvokeSendMessageChunkPrivate(sendTelegram, message, partNumber, totalParts, mockHttpClient);

        // Assert - Verify the request URL contains the expected part formatting
        mockHttpMessageHandler.Protected()
            .Verify("SendAsync", Times.Once(),
                ItExpr.Is<HttpRequestMessage>(req => 
                    req.RequestUri.ToString().Contains($"Part {partNumber}/{totalParts}")),
                ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>());
    }

    private static async Task InvokeSendMessageChunkPrivate(SendTelegramMessage sendTelegram, string message, int partNumber, int totalParts, HttpClient client)
    {
        var method = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetMethod("SendMessageChunk", 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
        
        // Use reflection to inject the HttpClient since HttpClientHelper.CreateClient() is static
        var clientField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("client", 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
        clientField?.SetValue(sendTelegram, client);

        await (Task)method!.Invoke(sendTelegram, [message, partNumber, totalParts])!;
    }
}

            // Try to find and replace the client field if it exists, otherwise the test will use real HttpClient
            var clientField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("client", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            clientField?.SetValue(sendTelegram, client);
        }

        await (Task)method!.Invoke(sendTelegram, [message, partNumber, totalParts])!;
    }
